title: Shiny Items
description: Vanilla+ Resource pack that adds a spark/shine on items that MUST shine!
body:
![Shiny Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0604302290fef70e61826430d1ed6e83a9cb422.png)
#  **IMPORTANT NOTICE** :
### **The ResourcePack is made to work at all versions (Not tested), But sometimes it will say that the resource pack is for an older or a newer version, even if it says that, the resourcepack will still work**
**This Resource Pack is a must for a vanilla+ Modpack, since it adds these "Shines/Sparks" To specific items that should shine.**
#  Current Items List :
1. Amethyst Shard
2. Golden Apple (Needs rework)
3. Enchanted Golden Apple (Needs rework)
4. Emerald
5. Diamond
6. Gold Ingot
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   This resource pack gets updated almost weekly (Sometimes daily) Also if you enjoy this resource pack, Please consider subscribing to my youtube channel : @mkj_ljx
